title: UTA100 GPX linked from the 2027 race page — file header and measurements
claims: The GPX URL sits in a folder named '2026 RACE ALIGNMENTS' and the file is named uta_100k_cleaned_livetrail_f81c7a5085.gpx, while the page that links it is the 2027 UTA100 page.

The GPX creator is 'LiveTrail' and the version is 1.1; the metadata name is 'LiveTrail Race', the metadata copyright author is 'LiveTrail®' with a link to https://livetrail.run, and there is no metadata time element.
The file contains 5,984 track points in one track segment, no waypoints and no track name.
The first point is at -33.72879, 150.30047 at 960 m and the last point is at -33.72878, 150.30045 at 956.5 m, so the route starts and finishes at the same place.
Measured locally from the track points, the horizontal distance is 100.108 km and the three-dimensional distance including elevation is 101.446 km.
Raw positive and negative elevation change are 4,497 m and 4,500 m; applying a 3 m threshold gives 6,082 m of positive gain because the elevation series is noisy.
The highest point in the file is 1,071.5 m at about 10.53 km and the lowest is 220 m.
The last value of the per-point <extensions><distance> field is 101,106 m, which is the file's own cumulative distance.
